scope: Actual native decoder and shared chat manager only, with controlled identity/HTTP/socket inlets. No account, Keychain, preferences, UI, audio, capture/device, media/CDN or live provider/RTC operation.

eventSubscription.condition: Existing verified own broadcaster and chatting user
eventSubscription.otherNotices: Unknown, shared-chat and other unsupported notice types are ignored; source_broadcaster_user_id must be absent/null.

literalText: Provider system_message and message.text retained verbatim, joined by a newline only when both are nonempty; combined UTF-8 limit16384. No amount, duration, URL, HTML, image or inferred event fields retained.
privacy: Strict boolean chatter_is_anonymous overrides contradictory userID/name/badges; normalized author Anonymous, empty route authorID and roles.
mutation: Notice routes explicitly disallow mutation; actual reply, reviewed target, delete, timeout and ban paths refuse before any request. Ordinary chat routes retain current eligibility.
lifecycle: Exact fifth subscription ACK includes type/version/channel/user/socket. Migration transfers subscriptions without resubscribe; generation/cancellation fences reject held late socket and fifth ACK completion. Existing provider/message identity dedup and tombstones remain.
